scope: Actual loopback bridge run_python through existing UI-owned atomic engineering transaction; unsupported full Scene Python surfaces remain explicit refusals
authorization: engineering-python feature plus explicit default-off enable; no added token protocol

receipt.error: actual Python error string or null
receipt.changed: literal bool after accepted native publication

requirements: one existing Controller journal and App publication
bounded transcript refusal rather than truncation
no source capture before reviewed producer
no duplicated Undo snapshot or publication
keep core publication admission/history synchronization intact

stdio_scope.supported: bounded actual write (Unicode scalar return count), flush, isatty false, writable true, encoding null; actual interpreter traceback retained
stdio_scope.open: StringIO seek/tell/truncate/getvalue and broad stdlib stream compatibility remain unproved

strict_traceback: No synthesized CPython traceback; retain raw CPython and RustPython output differences as strict open if present
protocol_input_scope: String code uses genuine compiler/eval/exec. Nonstring code is retained original protocol evidence; native typed admission may remain strict discrepancy, never fabricated Python error.
